history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG - generic CSV name: many Shiva temples exist in Moga and no single canonical 'Shiv Mandir' could be established. The best-supported single referent is Baba Gokul Chand Shiv Mandir at Angad Pura Mohalla, Gita Colony, Moga 142001 - documented by akhandapp.in (rated 5.0 by 8 reviewers, phone +91 94174 20196) and resolved by geocoding at full-address level (relevance 100). Alternatives that must NOT be conflated: (a) SHIVALA Mandir, Main Bazaar, Krishna Nagar, Moga (onefivenine.com locality listing); (b) Shiv Ji Mandir, Mehna Hospital Street, Friends Colony, Moga (onefivenine.com; top-rated.online 5.0); (c) 'Shiv Mandir', Tarewala Link Rd, Moga; (d) Shiv Mandir, Kot Kapura-Moga Rd, Bagha Purana; (e) Shiv Temple listings in Guru Arjun Dev Nagar and Kartar Nagar. No founding history, festivals or hours are published for the Gita Colony shrine. CSV town (Moga) and state are correct. No reliable temple-specific photograph was found after genuine searching, so media is empty.
